pages.text: I awoke today to find myself in a world somewhat different from the one I came from. Magic fills the air, and I have a strange sense that there is more to learn about this world.$(br2)I will record observations I discover as I go. There are unexpected gaps in my memories, so first, I should give myself a once-over.

This journal seems to respond to discovery. New notes appear only after I have personally encountered, made, or understood the thing they concern.$(br2)Another person’s discoveries do not become mine. Whatever this book is, it records my memory alone.
pages.title: A Personal Record
